title: Choi Yena's heart-cutout dress draws Sabrina Carpenter comparisons

blocks.text: South Korean soloist Choi Yena found herself at the center of an online debate after her recent performance at the 2026 Melon Music Awards (MMA). Netizens quickly pointed out striking similarities between her stage aesthetic and the signature style of American pop star Sabrina Carpenter. The controversy erupted shortly after Choi took the stage on Saturday, Nov. 14, at the Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul. During her jazz-arranged performance of “Catch Catch,” the former IZ*ONE member wore a festive red dress. The outfit featured a prominent heart-shaped cutout right at the center of the bodice.
